== Ozma of Oz / A Record of Her Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas, the Yellow Hen, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion, and the Hungry Tiger; Besides Other Good People too Numerous to Mention Faithfully Recorded Herein ==

The Prince, whose name is Evring, is a Prince of Ev. Found as a small enchanted purple kitten, he had no memory of his past until Dorothy rescued him and returned him to his true form; once restored, he proudly announced his identity and lineage, though he recalled nothing of what had happened to him after his transformation.

By his own account, his father, the King, sold his mother and all her children to the cruel ruler of the Nomes. His brother Evardo, older than Evring, was among these siblings and stood to inherit their father's throne as King of Ev.

After his rescue, Evring rode with Dorothy upon the Sawhorse, having overcome his early shyness to become fond of the girl who had saved him. The two rode together and talked pleasantly, and Evring marveled, along with Dorothy, at Billina the hen's ability to speak sensibly.

During the journey, Evring came into unwitting possession of the Tin Woodman's enchanted whistle, having pocketed it without meaning to trap its owner. Billina revealed that the whistle, when touched and spoken over with the word "Ev," restored the Tin Woodman instantly. Evring, upon realizing the whistle had been taken from him in turn, cried out for its return.

=== Events ===

* Dorothy is allowed to guess and succeeds in freeing Prince Evring, the youngest son of the Queen of Ev.
* Billina reveals that Prince Evring had accidentally trapped the Tin Woodman by pocketing his enchanted whistle, and blowing it ("Ev") restores him instantly.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 4 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz ==

The Prince presides over the glass city of the Mangaboos, a vegetable people living beneath the earth's crust. His subjects address him as "my Lord," and when wonders appeared in the air, the Prince and all of his people flocked out of the hall into the street to see them. He listens with attention to those who address him, as when he remarked on a visitor "from the crust of the earth" who had called a companion a Wizard.

=== Events ===

* They land in the glass city of the Mangaboos, a vegetable people ruled by a Prince, where Jim and the kitten Eureka unexpectedly gain the power of speech.
* Dorothy and the Wizard pick the ripe Royal Princess from the Royal Bush, and she deposes the Prince to become the new ruler of the Mangaboos.
* Ozma crowns Sawhorse "Prince of Horses" and Tin Woodman repairs its leg and ear.
</div>

== Narrative role ==

Prince Evring is a Prince of Ev, the youngest son of the Queen of Ev, who had been enchanted as a purple kitten after his father the King sold his mother and all her children to the cruel ruler of the Nomes, the Nome King. Dorothy is allowed to guess among the Nome King's ornaments and succeeds in freeing him, restoring Evring to his true form. Once free, Evring rides with Dorothy upon the Sawhorse, having recovered from his early shyness and grown fond of the girl who rescued him; the two become fast friends and converse pleasantly as they travel, and Evring marvels that Billina, a hen, can talk and say such sensible things.

Later, Billina reveals that Evring had accidentally trapped the Tin Woodman by pocketing his enchanted whistle without realizing what it did, and that blowing the whistle while saying Ev restores the Tin Woodman instantly. Evring protests that he only took the whistle, and when Billina reclaims it he begins to cry and asks for it back, prompting Billina to hush him.

== Personality ==

Evring shows an early pride in his own identity and lineage: recovering his memory, he announces, "I am a Prince of Ev, and my name is Evring," proudly, before recounting his family's fate at the hands of the Nome King. This same proclamation reveals a residual attachment to his lost family, since he can recall nothing beyond his parents' misfortune yet still identifies himself first and foremost as their son.

Though initially shy, he warms quickly to those who help him: once free of enchantment, he becomes very fond of Dorothy, riding beside her and chatting pleasantly, suggesting a trusting and affectionate disposition once his reserve is overcome.

His reaction to the whistle incident reveals a more childlike, defensive streak. Accused by Billina of having trapped the Tin Woodman in his pocket, he protests indignantly, "I did not!", before immediately qualifying his denial with "I only took the whistle" — an instinct to deny wrongdoing paired with an underlying honesty that will not let the correction stand uncorrected. When the whistle is subsequently taken from him, he begins to cry and demands, "I want my whistle!", betraying a childish attachment to small possessions and an emotional volatility consistent with his youth.

== Appearance ==

Evring is described as a small child, referred to as "the little one" and "the little Prince." Before his true form was restored, he had been transformed into a purple kitten, a shape from which Dorothy rescued him.

== Trivia ==

* Evring once carried the Tin Woodman's enchanted whistle in his pocket without realizing what it was capable of; when Billina touched it and spoke the word "Ev," the Tin Woodman appeared at once, restored from wherever the whistle had held him.
* When the whistle was taken from him so the Tin Woodman could be freed, Evring protested and cried, "I want my whistle!"
